name: School of Lust
source:
A boy genius gets mysteriously transferred to the prestige school, Harfort. A school where only the brightest and most exclusive students are blessed to study.

It doesn't take long for the boy to find out that Harfort is an all-girls school, and he's the first boy to attend. During his eventful stay, he unravels the reason why he was transferred to this secretive place, and why some of the female students have been missing...

An unique Visual Novel + RPG + Dungeon Crawler + Life/Dating Simulator hybrid game.

[From [url=http://www.schooloflust.com]http://www.schooloflust.com[/url]]
translation:
一名天才男孩神秘地转学到哈福特名校。这是一所只有最聪明、最优秀的学生才有幸学习的学校。

没过多久，男孩就发现哈福特是一所女子学校，而他是第一个入学的男孩。在他多事的逗留期间，他解开了自己被转移到这个秘密地方的原因，以及一些女学生失踪的原因……

一款独特的视觉小说+角色扮演+地下城探索+生活/约会模拟器混合游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.schooloflust.com]http://www.schooloflust.com[/url]]
